items.title: Mark Soskin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 17, 2021
items.q: And I wanted, at the time, Bennie Maupin, Harvey Mason, you know it was Herbie’s band you know.

ctx.x: That’s right. I mean for this record I specifically, I mean because Orrin said, he said basically get who you want. And I wanted, at the time, Bennie Maupin, Harvey Mason, you know it was Herbie’s band you know. And so I got these guys and that was, you know, it was great. And “Walk Tall” that was that.
Why do you think people, I mean your list of recordings as a sideman for one thing is close to one hundred or maybe over that by now.
